title: ClickFix, Electron Script-jacking, and Mandatory User Profiles
author: sonny
description: This attack simulation is inspired by Seqrite Lab's Operation HanKook Phantom: North Korean APT37 targeting South Korea and Praetorian's Corrupting the Hive Mind: Persistence Through Forgotten Windows Internals. It relies on a simple ClickFix attack to launch a PowerShell script that drops a Loki C2 payload, which is in turn used to establish persistence with a Mandatory User Profile.
body:
This attack simulation is inspired by Seqrite Lab's Operation HanKook Phantom: North Korean APT37 targeting South Korea and Praetorian's Corrupting the Hive Mind: Persistence Through Forgotten Windows Internals. It relies on a simple ClickFix attack to launch a PowerShell script that drops a Loki C2 payload, which is in turn used to establish persistence with a Mandatory User Profile.

See https://detection.wiki/labs/clickfix-electron-script-jacking-and-mandatory-user-profiles/ for full KQL queries and telemetry walkthrough.
